# Improve invoice review

## Problem
Invoice review takes too long.

## Actors
Finance reviewers and request submitters.

## Current Process
Reviewers compare invoices manually.

## Desired Change
Reduce manual comparison work.

## Success Measure
Average review time decreases.

## Business Constraints
No business constraints
